summary: Bug-fix verification after code review. Backend: 16/16 pytest pass (hakediş pay nakit/çek/draft-guard/auto-close to odendi, check endorse with/without hakediş + guards, client_key idempotency, import validation (missing collection / doc without id / non-JSON -> 400, stats + restore_points unchanged), export v1 with all 15 collections, pull dry_run against self returns preview with no data change, pull bad creds 400, non-admin 403 on export/stats/import/pull). Frontend (mobile 390x844): SW CacheStorage contains only '/', /api/settings/manifest.json, /api/settings/logo (no authenticated /api entries); /islemler pending row shows amount top-right and approve/reject buttons for admin, no horizontal overflow; /takvim renders calendar-page + cal-grid, clicking a day opens cal-day-sheet with the right item; /telefona-kur shows push-card, apns-key-card, fcm-key-card; admin page shows data-transfer-card and export-button (export download works); logout goes to /giris and clears dvt_token. All TEST_ data was cleaned up (admin stats are identical to the starting values).

minor.issue: endorse_check sets check_id=<received check id> on the endorsement transaction. delete_tx then deletes the ORIGINAL received check and its reminders (db.checks.delete_one({'id': t['check_id']})) instead of reverting it to 'portfoyde'. Deleting a ciro transaction makes the received check disappear.
If a ciro transaction (onay_bekliyor) is rejected, the check stays 'ciro_edildi' with endorsed_to set. It should revert to portfoyde, or the check should only become ciro_edildi after approval.

The dedup is a find_one followed by an insert, with no unique index on (created_by, client_key). Two concurrent offline-queue flushes can still create duplicates. Add a partial unique index and handle DuplicateKeyError.
Does not cascade or unlink transactions that carry progress_payment_id, which leaves orphan links.

The restore point is stored as a single JSON string in one Mongo document, so it will fail at the 16MB BSON limit as the data grows (blobs are excluded, which helps). There is also a non-atomic window between db[c].drop() and the rename.

ui_bugs.issue: LABELS[k].toLowerCase() on 'İşlem' renders 'i̇şlem' (a dotted-i combining character). Use toLocaleLowerCase('tr-TR').

issues: The status badge is followed by a dangling '-' separator when there is no approver
/yonetim alone redirects to '/'. The admin page lives at /yonetim/kullanicilar. Consider redirecting /yonetim to /yonetim/kullanicilar.

action_items: delete_tx: for endorsement transactions (endorsed=True), revert the check to portfoyde and clear endorsed_* instead of deleting the received check
Reject flow: revert the endorsed check status when its transaction is rejected
Add a unique partial index on transactions(created_by, client_key) to make the dedup race-safe
critical_code_review_comments: pay_progress and endorse_check now pass BackgroundTasks correctly. This is verified fixed (201, no 500s).
sw.js correctly bypasses non-public /api GETs. Logout posts clear-cache. The cache key 'devrantas-v3' reappears after logout because the /giris navigation re-caches '/', which is harmless.
The test file must be run with -n 0 (serially) because pytest.ini enables xdist, and parallel workers make the admin-stats before/after equality checks fail.
seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_ site, account, hakedişler, checks, transactions and sub-user were created and all deleted. Final stats match the starting values (checks=0, transactions=26, test_records=0, users=6).
